why: The one review of slice 10 of the Reflect ban (0554) in next/, libfabrika's cloudflare/ folder: commits 6a3ff1629 (tests) and 87e2b274a (build) on fabrikalfa/reflect-rest at 87e2b274a, against docs/plan/quests/reflect-ban-PLAN.md signed at 4e9601147 with amendment point 7. Sent back to the tests step, two blocking classes. (1) Kind 5 is not built as the plan says: the plan's table maps each name to a call that decodes its own arguments (plan lines 177-193; 0554 asks control.ts for a table of typed functions), and L8 says the door calls the method with the decoded arguments. The build checks only the name; its private call helper (control.ts:78-82) takes the method as (...args: never) => Effect and calls it with Reflect.apply, whose any answer is annotated as Effect<unknown, unknown>, so every argument crosses past the method's own types (control.ts:138, :150, :159). The builder is right that L8 as written cannot be met by the plan's shape: its generator gives only fc.array(fc.jsonValue()) arguments (control.laws.test.ts:105-121) and its coverage needs record:called with those arguments and the stub's arguments equal to the raw JSON (:226-252), and no Record method takes a random JSON value. So the tests step changes L8 first, then the build adds the decoders and drops the call helper. (2) Six @ts-expect-error lines on a settingsStart member answering StartsTest.reply are not kind 10: the law feeds a good start, not a value the type refuses on purpose, and the answer can be typed as the member's. A scratch file compiled Stub.make<ProjectBinding>(unexpected, { settingsStart: async () => ({ _tag: 'ok' as const, value: StartsTest.receipt(good) }) }) with no error, while StartsTest.reply(good) failed with TS2322 only because StartsTest's local Reply types value as unknown. Lines: ObjectService.test.ts:327, alarm.laws.test.ts:172 and :382, error-cause.test.ts:202, index.test.ts:105, p14.test.ts:57. The other two @ts-expect-error lines (platform.test.ts:167, the bridge's error envelope; p14.test.ts:64, the canned answer) are the kind 10 cases point 7 names. Every loosening.sh removed-expect hit (6 laws in platform.test.ts, 1 in ObjectService.test.ts) is a Reflect.get read rewritten as assert(x instanceof C) plus the typed field: each keeps its old check and adds an instanceof, so it is stricter; no law is loosened.
